name: Import user
description: Fill an account from a user:export made by this or another venue. The target is registered when absent and must otherwise hold no user state. Sealed secrets open with seed and are re-encrypted under this venue's key. Covia's migrations of its stored shapes run as part of the import. An export written by a newer Covia, or holding a job not yet finished or an agent task outstanding, is refused. Agent wakes are re-armed in this venue's schedule; references from the state to anything outside it are carried as stored. Requires venue-issued user/import on <venueDID>/users.

did.description: Exact DID of the account to fill

export.description: The export from user:export, as a blob or hexadecimal (optional 0x prefix)

seed.description: Secret reference (s/NAME or <did>/s/NAME) to the 32-byte hexadecimal Ed25519 seed the export's secrets were sealed to. Required when the export holds secrets. Never pass a raw seed.

created.description: True when the import registered the account
